messages:
Hannah (Finance): Heads up 026-02 billing experiment flagged an anomaly: Vendor 'ScaleSense' was billed ~1.45M embedding units but our analytics shows 950k. Can billing + SRE check?
Luis (Billing): show me invoice line and the experiment tag.
Hannah (Finance): invoice INV-SCALESENSE-202602 contains 1,450,000 embeddings billed. Our analytics query (from experiments tag 'pricing-variant-b') returns 952,314.
Vik (Customer Success): ScaleSense says they were in the pricing experiment variant that applied a temporary multiplier for embeddings; they expected net billed after multiplier. Are we double-applying multiplier and raw metering?
Anya (SRE): quick triage: metering pipeline tags events with experiment_id at ingestion. There was a join bug in billing-transform that applied the experiment multiplier twice for events that passed through the legacy & new tag paths during a migration window (2026-02-14 12:00 - 12:20Z). commit: git/commit/9f8b2d1 deployed 2026-02-15.
pricing-bot: experiment-run pricing-variant-b applied multiplier=1.2 for embeddings. duplicate_apply_count=1, affected_rows_estimate=500,000 job=exp-fix-20260305
Anya (SRE): the overlap window shows ~497,400 events with experiment tag duplicated. That explains the ~500k unit delta.
Luis (Billing): dollar impact? ScaleSense on hosted plan rate $0.0004 per unit. delta ~497,686 => $199.07.
Hannah (Finance): propose issuing credit memo CM-8399 for $199.07 and correcting billed units to 952,314 in accounting records. Need Maya approval and GL code.
Maya (Finance Director): approve $199.07 credit. GL=BILL-ADJ-EXP2026. Note: root cause = experiment multiplier applied twice during tag migration window; remediation deployed git/commit/9f8b2d1. Please include summary in monthly ops.
Luis (Billing): created CM-8399 $199.07 applied to INV-SCALESENSE-202602; added note and evidence (query hashes). Notified customer via CS.
Vik (Customer Success): ScaleSense acknowledged and appreciated quick handling. Will share logs if they want more detail.
Anya (SRE): follow-ups: 1) scan for other experiment overlaps (job exp-overlap-scan-20260305) 2) add unit test to prevent double-apply in transform 3) add an alert on experiment multiplier application counts.
Hannah (Finance): thanks all. Closing this thread for ScaleSense; will batch if scan finds more affected vendors.
